items.question: Which old spellings besides the enum values are read as a status?
items.ticket: Existing values are normalised when read
items.chose: Maps only the cleaned form "in review" to review, so "in-review", "In Review" and "in_review" all read as review.
items.instead: Also map other likely variants, such as "in progress" or "pending", or accept any prefix or near match.

items.question: How is a stored value cleaned before it is matched?
items.ticket: Existing values are normalised when read
items.chose: Lowercases the value, collapses runs of spaces, "-" and "_" into one space, and trims the ends.
items.instead: Only trim and lowercase, or strip separators entirely so that "dr-aft" reads as draft.

items.question: What does reading an unrecognised stored value return?
items.instead: Throw an error, or fall back to a default such as draft.

items.question: What does reading an empty or whitespace-only value return?
items.chose: Returns null, because the cleaned empty string matches nothing.
items.instead: Treat it as draft, the default status.

items.question: Does writing a status normalise near-miss input such as "Draft" or "in-review"?
items.chose: Accepts only the exact lowercase enum strings and throws for everything else, including a different case, padding or an old spelling.
items.instead: Normalise the input with the read logic first and then write the enum value.

items.question: How does writing an invalid status fail?
items.chose: Throws an Error whose message contains the JSON-quoted value.
items.instead: Return null or undefined, or return a result object, without throwing.

items.question: What happens in a batch read when a row's status cannot be read?
items.chose: Keeps the row in the output with status null and records the value as unreadable, without failing the batch.
items.instead: Drop the row from the output, or throw for the whole batch.

items.question: How are unreadable values reported in a batch read?
items.chose: Lists each original stored string once, de-duplicated by exact raw value ("Lost" and "  Lost  " stay separate), sorted with the default sort.
items.instead: De-duplicate on the cleaned form, report the cleaned value, or keep first-seen order.

items.question: Is the output order of rows kept in a batch read?
items.chose: Keeps the input order, one output row per input row, with duplicate ids kept.
items.instead: De-duplicate rows by id or sort them.
